selected_scope.finding: Existing Offense evidence does not establish an LC Office-specific low generated-count regression. S1.42AJ-DIAG1 LC Office generated 14 base scrap plus one additional replicated object (15 tracked total); S1.42AJ-DIAG2 LC Office generated/finalized 15. Comparable normal Offense runs start from 14 base scrap: S1.42AJ Facility was later inflated by BCMER PlentyOutsideScrap, while accepted S1.42AK Spooky Manor finalized at 15. Placement/discoverability remains unresolved. S1.42AK-SCRAPDIAG1 is now implemented and statically validated but not published or armed.
selected_scope.analysis_contract: Generated quantity remains provisionally comparable; do not increase scrap count. The placement diagnostic is implemented and statically validated against exact accepted S1.42AK: reviewed AJDIAG1 LC Office selection plus one read-only RoundManager.SpawnScrapInLevel postfix with two bounded delayed snapshots, world positions, EntranceTeleport floor anchors and support-collider hierarchy paths. Static validation proves exactly two added diagnostic DLLs and no changed/removed existing archive members. No gameplay or network state may be mutated. Runtime placement conclusions remain unproven.
selected_scope.next_action: Publish and arm the exact pinned S1.42AK-SCRAPDIAG1 review artifact in a separate explicit lifecycle transition. Until that transition completes, keep BuildSpecs/current.json disabled, RuntimeInbox/ACTIVE_BUILD.txt at S1.42AK, active_candidate null and runtime_test_outstanding false.
